run_cache_replica: run the script to cache visual observations for Replica dataset scenes
run_cache_mp3d: run the script to cache visual observations for Matterport3D dataset scenes
create_sim: create a habitat simulator configuration from a scene id and sensor suite
cache_scene_observations: cache RGB and depth observations for all grid points and angles in a scene
save_scene_observations: save cached scene observations as a pickle file per scene
